verdict.rationale: Clara documents an API reference with complete, runnable code examples per language, plus an introductory example request. The OpenAPI 3.1 schema is confirmed by probe. Nothing shows the reference itself is interactive, such as an in-browser try-it console. Postman import is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it or playground in the API reference, and hands-on corroboration that the examples run as documented.
